questions.question: In the context of Lisa's research project, Dr. Harris suggests she should?

analyses.content: 导师提醒现阶段要保持开放的心态（keep an open mind），根据初步发现来做出回应，这说明你需要灵活变通，对应选项 B 中的 flexible。
你很容易因为导师刚开始夸了一句研究重心“准确（spot on）”就掉以轻心，从而忽略了后面紧跟在转折词 But 之后真正的核心建议。
Excellent. And your focus, the role of a health visitor in the community, is spot on. But at this stage, you need to keep an open mind so you can respond to initial findings once you get underway.

questions.question: Which topic area does Dr. Harris advise Lisa to avoid investigating?

analyses.content: 你一口气列举了托儿所、学前班和照看儿童的人（child minders），导师最后明确表态“照看儿童的人”这个领域太复杂，建议避开（stay clear of），对应选项 C。
录音里连续放出了三个干扰选项对应的实体词，你如果不耐心听到导师最后针对最后一个词给出的评价，很容易听到哪个就随便选哪个。

Another area which I am thinking of investigating is the monitoring of nurseries, which is currently under review. And there is the issue of preschools, at what age they should take very young children. I thought I'd also include child minders, the individuals in the area of Haynes that might not be qualified, but look after young children. That's an area I'd stay clear of, as it's very complex.

questions.question: The main reason why Lisa wants to film very young children is

analyses.content: 你在长句的最后用 although 转折，明确说明“早期语言的使用（early use of language）”才是你最主要的兴趣点，直接对应选项 C。
录音中间大段描述了看孩子们怎么玩耍（play）和相处（peer relationships），你如果不往后听到最后一句的转折强调，就会选错成 A 或 B。

Anyway, I'd also like to make a short film about a few children. A good idea, but it will depend on building up a relationship with one or 2 health visitors willing to introduce you to a family. An opportunity like that would allow you to look at how young children begin to form words, for example. And peer relationships between children, as well as the ways in which they relate and play with each other, especially when they are around 2 to 3 years old, although early use of language is my main interest.

options.option: Parents may be put under pressure.
options.optionContent: Parents may be put under pressure.

options.option: Sufficient support may not be available.
options.optionContent: Sufficient support may not be available.

questions.question: According to Dr. Harris, how might the arrival of a new baby affect a family?

analyses.content: 导师指出新生儿会给父母带来影响，尤其是额外的经济花销会成为一种担忧（expense could be a worry），这对应的就是父母承受的压力（pressure），对应选项 B。
你可能会凭生活经验脑补新生儿会让其他孩子嫉妒（jealous），但录音里明确列举的例子是给父母带来的“经济环境”烦恼，做题绝不能靠常识瞎猜。

An equally important area is the child's home environment and the effect of a newborn baby. Right. You need to consider the impact of this on the parents, particularly if the family lives in poor economic circumstances. Of course, the additional expense could be a worry, especially if there are other children.

questions.question: Dr. Harris agrees with Lisa that she needs to find out about

analyses.content: 你问是不是要熟悉家庭法，导师不仅大力赞同，还强调必须参考法律（refer to the law）来界定干预的程度，完全对应选项 A 中的法律限制。
导师中间故意抛出了医疗条件（medical conditions）和社会实践（social practice）来做干扰，如果你没跟上最后用 But 引出的关于法律（law）的核心结论，就会踩坑。

This is the area where I will need to be familiar with family law, isn't it? Very much so. By all means, be aware of the medical conditions, and you also need to consider social practice. But you'll find that in most circumstances, you will have to refer to the law to understand how far a health visitor can intervene. Yes, I appreciate that.

analyses.content: 你提到这书是新版所以信息很新（current），导师补充说能借此了解其他国家（other countries）的发展，两者结合就是“更新及时且有国际视野”，对应选项 D。
导师说书里有些内容“可能不相关（may not be relevant）”，你千万别把它当成了“不准确（inaccurate）”而误选了 A。

Now, your book list. I'm glad to see Worldwide Health Care Policies tops your list. Well, I wasn't sure how relevant it would be, but it's a new edition, so the information is current. Yes, some of it may not be relevant, but it's important to keep abreast of developments in other countries which may inform our own government's legislation.
导师明确夸这本书考虑到价格的话非常划算（excellent buy），尽管它确实遗漏了一些东西（leave a few things out），对应选项 F 的性价比高且有疏漏。
你听到“遗漏（leave out）”这个缺点时，不能只看带贬义的选项，必须结合前面的“不那么贵/买得值（not as costly / excellent buy）”做正负向的综合判断。

I understand. What about Supporting Vulnerable Families? It's not as costly as some of the other books on my list. It's an excellent buy considering the price, even though it does leave a few things out.
导师直言这本书非常昂贵（very expensive），但没有几本书能像它一样涵盖这么多的细节（cover as much detail as this），精准对应选项 G。
导师最后随口吐槽了一句文风偶尔无聊（boring），如果你注意力被带偏去选带负面评价的干扰项，就漏掉了“投资很值且内容详尽”的核心结论。

I've already ordered Health Visitors and Child Protection. I hope that was right. Well, it's very expensive, but it's a sound investment, and there aren't many textbooks which cover as much detail as this. It will be a valuable reference, even if the style is occasionally boring.
导师觉得这本书很有启发性（stimulating），但探讨的都是基于“完美世界”和“钱不是问题”这种不太现实（unrealistic）的假设，对应选项 B。
你听到“不具备实用价值（Probably not useful）”可能会直接找纯负面选项，但忽略了后面紧跟着的正面词“启发思考（stimulating）”，要找正负结合的选项。

And what about The Future of Health Visiting? I'm unsure how useful it will be. Useful in a utilitarian sense? Probably not. But it's stimulating in the way the writer considers what health visiting could be like in a perfect world. I'd suggest dipping into it to discover the improvements which could be made if money were no object.
导师肯定了这本书内容丰富（huge variety），但立刻批评它呈现方式杂乱无章（haphazard way），连索引都没啥用，对应选项 E 的范围广但组织混乱。
即使你在考场上没听懂 haphazard（杂乱的）这个难词，只要抓住了转折词 but 以及后面跟着的具体例子“索引没用（index isn't much use）”，也能推断出是排版组织出了问题。

And Resources for Health Visitors? Strangely enough, it's not as helpful as the title suggested. It offers a huge variety of activities and strategies which are great when working with young children, but they're presented in a rather haphazard way, and the index isn't much use either. Be very careful when using it.
